title: Liquid Carat — Grand
subtitle: Round brilliants in a continuous line, moving with the wrist. No clasp, no closure.

stone.origin: Natural. No clasp — continuous flex setting.

description: The Liquid Carat™ at fuller weight — round brilliant diamonds set in a continuous, no-clasp line that still moves like liquid despite its scale. There is no hinge and no closure; the stones pour around the wrist and catch light in an unbroken run as the hand turns. At this proportion the line reads with genuine presence, a broad continuous flow of brilliance rather than a fixed band. It is the Liquid Carat™ idea carried toward its fullest expression. Made to order in the metal chosen at commission.
